summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Intermap Technologies Corporation providing notice of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 24, 2026, along with related materials such as the information circular and proxy form. The document uses the 'notice and access' model for electronic delivery of meeting materials. Routine matters to be voted on include the annual report, election of directors, and appointment of auditors. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. This is an ordinary shareholder meeting notification.
